modes_and_events: Build a closed-loop tiltrotor VTOL flight model in Simulink.
Read MissionKind, InitialFlightMode, MissionProfile, PayloadScale, EnableWind and SimulationDuration_s from the MATLAB base workspace.
The transition must acquire forward airspeed while continuously tilting the front rotors and avoiding excessive altitude loss or prolonged command saturation.

interfaces.name: MissionKind
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read MissionKind, InitialFlightMode, MissionProfile, PayloadScale, EnableWind and SimulationDuration_s from the MATLAB base workspace. MissionKind is a scalar integer in {1, 2, 3} for hover waypoint, hover-to-fixed-wing transition, and fixed-wing waypoint-orbit missions; InitialFlightMode is a scalar integer 0 (hover) or 2 (fixed wing); MissionProfile is an N-by-8 real matrix ordered [mission operation code, north position (m), east position (m), down position (m), operation parameters 1-4], with operation codes 1 (arm or initialize), 2 (track waypoint), 3 (track orbit using columns 5-8), 4 (land), and 6 (change between hover and forward-flight configuration); PayloadScale is a real scalar in [0.9, 1.1] (multiplicative mass factor); EnableWind is a scalar logical; and SimulationDuration_s is a real scalar in [30, 60] s.

interfaces.name: PositionTracking
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named PositionTracking, TransitionState, VehicleState, and ActuatorCommand. PositionTracking has 6 channels in this order: commanded north, east, and down position, followed by measured north, east, and down position, all in m.

interfaces.name: TransitionState
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named PositionTracking, TransitionState, VehicleState, and ActuatorCommand. TransitionState has 4 channels in this order: airspeed (m/s), front-rotor tilt angle (rad), pitch angle (rad), and altitude above the local ground plane (m).

interfaces.name: VehicleState
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named PositionTracking, TransitionState, VehicleState, and ActuatorCommand. VehicleState has 13 channels in this order: north, east, and down position (m); north, east, and down velocity (m/s); roll, pitch, and yaw (rad); body roll, pitch, and yaw rate (rad/s); and airspeed (m/s).

interfaces.name: ActuatorCommand
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named PositionTracking, TransitionState, VehicleState, and ActuatorCommand. ActuatorCommand has 10 channels in this order: front-left, front-right, rear-right, and rear-left rotor-speed commands in rev/s; front-left and front-right rotor-tilt commands (rad); aileron, elevator, and rudder commands (rad); and the forward-thrust rotor-speed-increment command in rev/s.
